description: This file defines the ProfilerExtension class for Twig, providing profiling capabilities by managing Profile instances and node visitors.

classes.name: ProfilerExtension
classes.description: A Twig extension for profiling that manages active Profile instances and provides node visitors for profiling Twig templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the extension with a Profile instance.

methods.name: enter
methods.description: Marks the entry point in profiling by adding a Profile to the active stack.

methods.name: leave
methods.description: Marks the exit point in profiling, removing a Profile from the active stack and handling nested profiles.

methods.name: getNodeVisitors
methods.description: Returns an array containing a ProfilerNodeVisitor for Twig's internal profiling.
